business_problem: Aztec Group is undertaking a digital transformation to drive efficiencies and manage risk, taking a “Microsoft first” approach.
solution_summary: Aztec Group is undertaking a digital transformation to drive efficiencies and manage risk, taking a “Microsoft first” approach. To maximise the return from its existing Microsoft tech stack, Aztec Group undertook a trial of Copilot for Microsoft 365 with 300 of its staff. With locations in the six strategic jurisdictions of Guernsey, Ireland, Jersey, Luxembourg, the United Kingdom, and the United States, Aztec employs 2,000+ people. It is a trusted partner for over 450 funds and has over €600bn in assets under administration (AUA) under its care. “It’s important for Aztec to scale our industry operations and technology is a massive enabler for that,” says Charlotte Light, Chief Digital Officer at Aztec Financial Services.

solution_components.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Assists employees inside Microsoft 365 apps with drafting, summarization, search, and task execution.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Connects users, experts, or frontline staff for collaboration, communication, and workflow execution.

solution_components.name: SharePoint
solution_components.role: Stores and shares documents and structured content used across the workflow.

data_flow: All the data handled by Copilot is compliant with Aztec’s data security policies and Microsoft’s commitments to data protection, privacy, security, compliance and responsible AI practices, including GDPR and the EU data boundary.
business_outcome: Based on these early successes, Aztec is now planning to scale to 1,000 users this year and, subsequently, to roll Copilot out to everyone in the organisation.
architecture_clues: To maximise the return from its existing Microsoft tech stack, Aztec Group undertook a trial of Copilot for Microsoft 365 with 300 of its staff.

As part of this digitalisation programme, Aztec Group gave 300 members of staff access to Copilot for Microsoft 365 so they could assess, in a safe and compliant way, the value AI could add to the way they work.
Copilot works with the data Aztec stores in its Microsoft Teams and SharePoint workspaces and the other Microsoft tools the business uses every day, including Word Excel PowerPoint Outlook .

All the data handled by Copilot is compliant with Aztec’s data security policies and Microsoft’s commitments to data protection, privacy, security, compliance and responsible AI practices, including GDPR and the EU data boundary.
